$comment: Reviewed exceptions to the standard coverage check (.github/scripts/check-standard-coverage.js). Each entry names a descriptor, the items it may miss and why. An item is a canonical function signature such as "transfer(address,uint256)", or "Permit" for the EIP-712 permit descriptor. On pull_request_target the check reads this file from the base branch, so add an exception in its own pull request, before the descriptor.
